_lexicon_comment: max_anchors + min_content_words were live knobs with no key here until 11 Aug 2026 — both carried their value as a literal in doubtminer.mjs, so neither could be audited or retuned from config. Both are written at their INCUMBENT values (nothing moves today): max_anchors 25 is the constant that produced every lexicon.json to date, min_content_words 1 is audit #4's MEASURED value. max_anchors is the one that was cutting his voice in silence — see doubtminer.mjs selectAnchors.
